items.a: CPSS is AAOIFI’s international certificate, and AAOIFI itself awards it through an exam. Mezon Ta’lim prepares you for that exam — the programme is built entirely on AAOIFI’s Shari’ah standards.

items.q: What language is the exam in?
items.a: The AAOIFI exam is currently held in English and Arabic. Lessons are in Uzbek, and alongside them the course drills bilingual terminology and exam-language question wording separately.
Your language level is assessed at the start of the course. The language bridge is inside the programme — we work on terminology and exam phrasing separately.
2 lessons a week, 70% online — the programme is designed precisely for people who are working. About 6 hours a week of lessons and independent study.

The strongest answer is what graduates got out of it. Among them are participants whose fee paid for itself 200% over, who signed a Musharaka contract during the course, and who corrected a Mudaraba agreement with a foreign partner.

items.q: Can we send staff as an organisation?
items.a: Yes. Group enrolment, corporate invoicing and an adapted schedule are available — see the “For organisations” section.

About.heroSubtitle: An online learning platform that teaches AAOIFI Shariah Standards in Uzbek through video lessons.
About.missionBody: Mezon Ta'lim aims to deliver the international AAOIFI standards in Islamic finance to professionals and students in Uzbekistan in a clear, structured and modern format. We turn complex standards into coherent video courses — so anyone can learn at their own pace.
About.aaoifiBody: AAOIFI (Accounting and Auditing Organization for Islamic Financial Institutions) is an international non-profit organization that develops accounting, auditing, governance and Shariah standards for Islamic financial institutions. Its standards are applied by Islamic banks and financial institutions worldwide.
About.affiliationBody: Mezon Ta'lim has an official partnership with AAOIFI. This guarantees that our programs are faithful to the source and trustworthy.
About.step1Body: Create an account in a few minutes and pick a course from the catalog.
About.step2Body: Modules and lessons unlock in sequence — learn at your own pace.
About.step3Body: Lesson quizzes, module tests and a final exam reinforce your knowledge.
About.step4Body: Score 70%+ on the final exam and receive your PDF certificate.

Faq.heroSubtitle: Answers to the most common questions.
Faq.contactNote: Didn't find an answer to your question? Get in touch.

items.q: How do I enroll in a course?
items.a: Sign up, choose a course from the catalog and pay via Click or Payme. Once payment is confirmed, the course opens automatically.
Currently Click and Payme are supported.

items.q: Do I get a certificate when I finish a course?
items.a: Yes. When you complete the course and score at least 70% on the final exam, a PDF certificate is issued automatically. Each certificate can be verified via a public verification page.

items.q: What languages are the courses in?
items.a: Currently the courses are in Uzbek. Russian is coming soon.

items.q: Can I download the video lessons?
items.a: No. The videos are view-only and cannot be downloaded.

items.q: How many times can I take the final exam?
items.a: You can take the final exam up to 3 times, with a 24-hour wait between attempts. There is also one mock exam available.
Yes. Each lesson unlocks after you complete the previous one. This helps you absorb the material consistently.

items.q: Where is my personal data stored?
items.a: All your personal data is stored on servers located in Uzbekistan — in line with the ZRU-547 law 'On Personal Data'.

items.q: Will I get AAOIFI's official credential?
items.a: Mezon Ta'lim issues its own course-completion certificate. AAOIFI's official professional credential is obtained through AAOIFI's own exam — we can help with registration.
